name: Shang Gou Training (Combat, Style)
body:
You use combat maneuvers to create an opening for a quick attack.

Prerequisites: Weapon Focus (shang gou), base attack bonus +2 or monk 2.

Benefit: Once per round, when you successfully disarm or trip an opponent with a shang gou, they provoke an attack of opportunity from you. This attack must be made with another light weapon or an unarmed strike. Additionally, when you wield two shang gou they gain the performance weapon quality.

Note Weapon style feats function the same as unarmed style feats except that they require the user to wield one or more specific weapons.
